items.title: Aagam Investments, Smallcap World Fund, Habrok India Master, Prudential Assurance Company pick up 5% stake in LEAP India
items.description: Amongst them, US-based Capital Group-owned Smallcap World Fund Inc has acquired additional 2% stake in LEAP India.

items.title: WeWork Global offloads 2.52% stake in WeWork India; Motilal Oswal, Citigroup, ICICI Prudential AMC among buyers
items.description: The 2.52 percent stake sold by WeWork Global in WeWork India Management was bought by four investors including Motilal Oswal AMC, Citigroup Global, and ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund.
